snippet.title: Two Point Museum: Fantasy Finds | OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
A realm of curious oddities seeks learned individuals for a new position: Fantasy Expert. Must be well versed in either Barbarian, Wizard, Rogue or Bard classes - and have a degree of strength, dexterity, intelligence or luck to your name… The purpose of your unique talents shall be revealed during expedition debriefing. Prepare yourselves, for adventure awaits!

Get ready to unlock a new theme and explore a mythical map with your specialised fantasy experts. Design and build a new area in any base game museums with your new hire(lings).

Fantasy Finds DLC Includes:
- 40 new exhibits with magical properties to hypnotise guests with… sometimes literally!
- New Expert type
- New map to explore
- Exclusive decorations, items and utility items
- Interactive displays
- Helicopter paint job
- 3 new guest archetypes

Two Point Museum: Fantasy Finds released on July 17th on PC (Steam, Epic) Xbox X/S & PlayStation 5. Early adopters can take advantage of a 10% discount for the first week of launch.
 
Play now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3592600/Two_Point_Museum_Fantasy_Finds/ 
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/two-point-museum-two-point-museum-fantasy-finds-487edf
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9n41zwk1dv1s
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/product/EP0177-PPSA19769_00-TPMUSEUMLEMBAS00

Two Point Museum is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2025.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185060/Two_Point_Museum/
Xbox X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/apps/9nfhrf1m4w3z
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10009660
